gloss: to line up in a single row/line

definitions.gloss: to line up in a single row; to form a single line / queue
definitions.explanation: A standard expression for people or things arranging themselves in one line. Frequently used as an instruction in schools, ticket queues, and public transit, and to describe orderly formations.

examples.japanese: {一列|いちれつ}に{並|なら}んで⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please line up in a single file.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一列|いちれつ}に{並|なら}んで⟦{歩|ある}いている→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: The children are walking in a single line.

examples.japanese: ⟦{改札|かいさつ}→改札：04120_kaisatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一列|いちれつ}に{並|なら}んでお⟦{待|ま}ち→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please wait in a single line in front of the ticket gate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{客|きゃく}さん→お客さん：10253_okyakusan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一列|いちれつ}に{並|なら}んで、⟦{開店|かいてん}→開店：14569_kaiten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}っていた→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
examples.english: Customers were lined up single-file in front of the shop, waiting for it to open.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{一列|いちれつ}→一列：11228_ichiretsu⟧ ('one row, one line') + ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (target particle) + ⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧ ('to be lined up, to stand in a row'). The ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ marks the configuration the subject arranges into.

USAGE:
- Standard instruction in schools, theme parks, polling stations, train platforms, and anywhere orderly queuing is expected.
- Used both for people queuing (front-to-back) and for objects arranged side by side in one row.
- The causative/transitive version — arranging things in a line — is ⟦{一列|いちれつ}→一列：11228_ichiretsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}べる→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一列|いちれつ}に{並|なら}んで⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧: please line up in one line
- {一列|いちれつ}に{並|なら}んで⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧: to wait in a single line
- {一列|いちれつ}に{並|なら}んで⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: to walk in single file
- ⟦{一列|いちれつ}→一列：11228_ichiretsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}べる→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧: to arrange [things] in a single line (transitive)
- ⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{一列|いちれつ}に{並|なら}ぶ: to line up neatly in a single row

RELATED WORDS:
- {二列|にれつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧: to line up in two rows
- {縦一列|たていちれつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧: to line up in a single vertical (front-to-back) line
- ⟦{横一列|よこいちれつ}→横一列：23543_yokoichiretsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧: to line up in a single horizontal row (side by side)
- ⟦{順番|じゅんばん}→順番：03283_junban⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧: to line up in order / take turns in line
- ⟦{列|れつ}→列：02171_retsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to form a line / queue

TRANSITIVITY:
- ⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧ is intransitive — the subject is what forms the line.
- ⟦{並|なら}べる→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧ is the transitive pair — used when someone actively arranges objects: {本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一列|いちれつ}→一列：11228_ichiretsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}べた→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧ ('I lined up the books in a single row').
